title: The World Faces a 'Supersized' El Niño Climate Event
subtitle: Global experts warn of extreme weather and rising temperatures as a powerful climate cycle begins.

summary.en: The world is entering a period of extreme weather caused by a record-breaking El Niño event. This natural phenomenon is expected to be the strongest in over 70 years, potentially lasting until 2027. Experts warn that it will increase global temperatures and cause severe droughts, floods, and storms. Governments are now urging citizens to prepare for potential emergencies and power shortages. Scientists emphasize that this event is intensified by the ongoing global climate crisis.
summary.zh: 全球正進入由破紀錄的聖嬰現象所引發的極端天氣時期。這種自然現象預計將是七十多年來最強的一次，可能持續到二零二七年。專家警告，這將導致全球氣溫升高，並引發嚴重的乾旱、洪水與風暴。各國政府目前正敦促民眾為潛在的緊急狀況與電力短缺做好準備。科學家強調，此事件因持續的全球氣候危機而變得更加劇烈。

paragraphs.en: The world has entered a dangerous period of extreme weather as a powerful climate event known as El Niño begins to affect many regions. According to the United Nations, this phenomenon is being "supersized" before our eyes. The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) reports that this could be the strongest El Niño in more than 70 years, with effects that may last until at least February 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著被稱為「聖嬰現象 (El Niño)」的強大氣候事件開始影響許多地區，全球已進入極端天氣的危險時期。根據聯合國的說法，這種現象正在我們眼前「急劇擴大」。世界氣象組織 (WMO) 報告指出，這可能是七十多年來最強的一次聖嬰現象，其影響至少會持續到二零二七年二月。

paragraphs.en: El Niño is a natural cycle that starts in the Pacific Ocean. It happens when wind patterns change, allowing warm water to spread across the ocean and release extra heat into the atmosphere. While El Niño is a natural event, scientists warn that it is now happening on top of rising global temperatures caused by human activity. This combination is pushing the planet into what UN Secretary-General António Guterres calls "uncharted waters."
paragraphs.zh: 聖嬰現象是一種始於太平洋的自然循環。當風向模式改變時，溫暖的海水會擴散至整個海洋，並將額外的熱量釋放到大氣中。雖然聖嬰現象屬於自然事件，但科學家警告，它現在是疊加在人類活動所導致的全球氣溫上升之上。這種結合正將地球推向聯合國秘書長古特瑞斯 (António Guterres) 所稱的「未知的領域」。

paragraphs.en: Data from the WMO shows that sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern Pacific have risen sharply. In some areas, temperatures are already more than 2 degrees Celsius above average. Forecasts suggest that these temperatures could eventually reach 4 degrees above average. According to analysis cited by The Guardian, historical data from tree rings and old documents suggest that no El Niño has reached this level in the last 1,000 years. This makes the current event a "Godzilla-level" situation that will likely make 2027 the hottest year ever recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 世界氣象組織的數據顯示，中太平洋與東太平洋的海面溫度已急劇上升。在某些地區，氣溫已比平均值高出攝氏兩度以上。預測顯示，這些氣溫最終可能達到比平均值高出四度的水準。根據《衛報 (The Guardian)》引述的分析，來自樹木年輪與古老文獻的歷史數據顯示，過去一千年來沒有任何一次聖嬰現象達到這種程度。這使得當前的事件成為一種「哥吉拉等級」的狀況，極可能讓二零二七年成為有紀錄以來最熱的一年。

paragraphs.en: The impacts of this event are already being felt globally. El Niño changes weather patterns, leading to severe droughts in some places and heavy flooding in others. For example, The Guardian reports that the event is already worsening wildfires in Indonesia and affecting monsoon rains. In Australia, researchers are worried about the health of the ocean. Dr. Alistair Hobday, a lead researcher, told the BBC that while the Great Barrier Reef might be safe for now, other parts of the country are facing serious threats, including marine heatwaves that harm local wildlife.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件的影響已在全球顯現。聖嬰現象改變了天氣模式，導致某些地方出現嚴重乾旱，另一些地方則發生嚴重洪災。例如，《衛報》報導指出，該事件已加劇了印尼的野火並影響了季風降雨。在澳洲，研究人員對海洋的健康狀況感到擔憂。首席研究員艾利斯泰爾·霍布戴 (Alistair Hobday) 博士告訴英國廣播公司 (BBC)，雖然大堡礁目前可能尚屬安全，但該國其他地區正面臨嚴重威脅，包括傷害當地野生動物的海洋熱浪。

paragraphs.en: Governments are taking these warnings very seriously. In the United Kingdom, officials have asked citizens to keep a supply of food and water at home. The goal is to ensure that people can survive for a few days without power or water if extreme winter storms cause emergencies. Angela Eagle, the UK environment secretary, explained to The Guardian that being prepared makes communities more resilient. She noted that while the UK might experience wetter winters and stronger storms, other parts of the world, especially in Asia, could face even more dangerous flooding.
paragraphs.zh: 各國政府正非常嚴肅地看待這些警告。在英國，官員已要求民眾在家中儲備食物與飲水。其目標是確保若極端冬季風暴引發緊急狀況，人們能在沒有電力或自來水的情況下生存幾天。英國環境大臣安琪拉·伊格 (Angela Eagle) 向《衛報》解釋，做好準備能讓社區更具韌性。她指出，雖然英國可能會經歷更潮濕的冬天與更強烈的風暴，但世界其他地區，特別是亞洲，可能會面臨更危險的洪水。

paragraphs.en: To reduce the risk of deaths and damage, the WMO has started a major effort to share its weather forecasts with as many communities as possible. They have strengthened early warning systems and are working to provide medical help before disasters happen. However, the strength of this specific El Niño remains a major concern for vulnerable groups around the world. Celeste Saulo, the WMO Secretary-General, warned that this event has the potential to deliver a massive blow to both communities and the global economy.
paragraphs.zh: 為了降低死亡與損害的風險，世界氣象組織已發起一項重大行動，致力於與盡可能多的社區分享天氣預報。他們加強了預警系統，並努力在災難發生前提供醫療協助。然而，這次聖嬰現象的強度對全球弱勢群體而言，仍是一個重大的隱憂。世界氣象組織秘書長塞萊斯特·紹洛 (Celeste Saulo) 警告，此事件有可能對社區與全球經濟造成巨大打擊。

paragraphs.en: As the world prepares for these challenges, scientists emphasize that the climate crisis—driven by pollution from fossil fuels—is already making extreme weather more common. The record-breaking heatwave that hit Europe this past summer resulted in at least 35,000 deaths, serving as a grim reminder of the risks. With El Niño expected to increase these effects, the race is now on to protect people and take meaningful climate action. As Guterres stated, the world is in a danger zone, and the decisions made now will determine how well we can handle the difficult months ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著世界為這些挑戰做好準備，科學家強調，由化石燃料污染所驅動的氣候危機，已使極端天氣變得更加頻繁。去年夏天襲擊歐洲、打破紀錄的熱浪造成至少三萬五千人死亡，這是一個關於風險的嚴峻提醒。隨著聖嬰現象預計將加劇這些影響，現在必須爭分奪秒地保護民眾並採取有意義的氣候行動。正如古特瑞斯所言，世界正處於危險地帶，現在所做的決定將決定我們能多好地應對未來艱難的幾個月。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make something much larger or more intense than usual.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意指速食店加大餐點份量，這裡用來形容氣候現象變得異常強烈。文中：According to the United Nations, this phenomenon is being "supersized" before our eyes.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation that is new, unknown, and potentially dangerous.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 未知的領域、前所未有的險境。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思是「未標示在海圖上的水域」，這裡比喻人類面臨前所未有的氣候危機。文中：This combination is pushing the planet into what UN Secretary-General António Guterres calls "uncharted waters."

keyTerms.definitionEn: A sudden, hard event that causes damage or disappointment.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（吹氣），這裡作名詞，指嚴重的負面影響。文中：Celeste Saulo, the WMO Secretary-General, warned that this event has the potential to deliver a massive blow to both communities and the global economy.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation where people are competing to do something as quickly as possible.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 競賽已經開始（指必須爭分奪秒地行動）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 用「競賽」來形容迫切需要採取行動的狀態。文中：With El Niño expected to increase these effects, the race is now on to protect people and take meaningful climate action.

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the expected duration of the current El Niño event?

options.D: Until the next monsoon season in Asia

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第一段最後一句明確指出，WMO 報告稱此次聖嬰現象的影響可能會持續到至少 2027 年 2 月。選項 A 並未在文中提及；選項 C 是關於此現象強度與過去 70 年相比的描述，而非持續時間；選項 D 雖然提到亞洲季風，但與持續時間無關。

quiz.question: Why does the author suggest that this El Niño is more dangerous than previous ones?

options.A: Because it is the first time El Niño has occurred in the Pacific Ocean
options.B: Because it is happening in isolation from other climate factors
options.C: Because it is occurring alongside existing human-caused global warming
options.D: Because it is expected to lower sea temperatures to record levels

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段，科學家警告聖嬰現象現在是疊加在人類活動導致的全球暖化之上，這使得地球進入了「未知的領域」。選項 A 錯誤，因為聖嬰現象是自然週期；選項 B 與文中提到的「疊加效應」相反；選項 D 錯誤，因為文章提到的是海面溫度上升，而非下降。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'the race is now on' imply?

options.A: Scientists are competing in a professional sports event
options.B: There is an urgent need to act quickly to prevent further harm
options.C: The climate crisis has become a game that people can win
options.D: The weather patterns are moving faster than ever before

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。片語 'the race is now on' 在此處並非指真正的體育競賽，而是隱喻為了應對氣候危機帶來的風險，人類必須爭分奪秒地採取行動。選項 A 是字面意思的誤解；選項 C 過於樂觀，文中並未將氣候危機視為可贏的遊戲；選項 D 雖然天氣模式在變化，但這句話強調的是人類的應對速度。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article?

options.A: The UK government is the only country taking the threat of El Niño seriously
options.B: El Niño is a harmless natural cycle that will soon disappear
options.C: New technology has made it possible to stop El Niño entirely
options.D: The current, record-breaking El Niño poses a severe global threat that requires urgent preparation and action

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章從聖嬰現象的強度、對全球的影響、各國的準備措施以及科學家的警告，共同傳達了此次現象的嚴重性以及全球合作應對的必要性。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到全球多地受影響；選項 B 與文章主旨完全相反；選項 C 文中並未提及有技術能停止聖嬰現象。
